result.description: Visual discovery platform; API v5 lets apps manage Pins, Boards, analytics, and ads/catalogs for users via OAuth.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (redirect URI exact match) with token refresh. 24h test tokens for Trial apps. Client-credentials not confirmed.
result.access_detail: Free developer signup, but Pinterest must approve the app for Trial access. Trial is sandbox-like: daily rate limits, Pins/Boards visible only to the creator. Production use needs Standard access via a demo-video review that shows the OAuth flow. Apps registered on or after 2026-09-14 may hit 403 PINNER_DATA_ACCESS_DENIED without user authorization.
result.api_notes: REST API v5 covers Pins, Boards, user account, pin analytics, ads (campaigns, ad groups, audiences), catalogs, and conversions. Python SDK exists.
result.blocker: Each app needs Pinterest approval for Trial access. Standard access (needed for other users in production) needs a demo-video review. The official MCP page looks pre-launch. Community servers such as terryso/mcp-pinterest exist.
